intro: Sleek Look Hair & Nails is a Fort Walton Beach salon known for natural-looking blonde, balayage and layered cuts. Clients say the stylists really listen, never rush, and leave hair looking soft, natural and healthy.

services.name: Color & highlights
services.desc: Dimensional highlights and all-over color with natural, soft results.

services.name: Balayage & blonding
services.desc: Hand-painted balayage and blonde transformations that keep hair looking healthy.

services.name: Nails
services.desc: Fresh, clean nail services to complete your look while you're here.
